$comment: Three hand-written, hand-verified decodable stories (NFR-5.2 offline mode, and the fallback whenever generation fails — the pipeline is fail-closed). World-seed tokens {{hero}}, {{sibling}}, {{pet}}, {{city}} are substituted at serve time so even cached stories carry the child's real life as canon. The core test suite re-validates decodability of every page on every build.

stories.title: The Dog in the Mud

pages.text: Tam can see the den. The den is in the mud.
pages.illustrationHint: flat three-ink scene: a small den in mud, warm sun

pages.text: The den is a cot. A dog is on the cot.
pages.illustrationHint: flat three-ink scene: a dog resting on a cot by the den

pages.text: The dog can not run. The dog is in the mud.
pages.illustrationHint: flat three-ink scene: a muddy dog trying to get up

pages.text: I can get the dog up! Tam ran to the cot.
pages.illustrationHint: flat three-ink scene: Tam running to help the dog

choice.prompt: The dog is on the cot. Can Tam sit on the cot?
options: Tam can sit on the cot. The dog can sit up on it.
Tam can get a rug. The dog can sit on the rug.
choice.consequenceForFirst: Tam and the dog sat on the cot. The sun is up. The dog can run.
choice.consequenceForSecond: Tam got a rug. The dog ran to the rug. The dog is up. It can run.

stories.offlineTask: Go and tell your grown-up what Tam did for the dog.

stories.title: The Web on the Hut

pages.text: {{hero}} and {{sibling}} can see the web. The web is on the hut.
pages.illustrationHint: flat three-ink scene: two children looking at a web on a hut wall

pages.text: A wasp is in the web. The wasp can not jump up.
pages.illustrationHint: flat three-ink scene: a small wasp caught in the web

pages.text: Oh no! {{pet}} will wag and jump. We can fix it!
pages.illustrationHint: flat three-ink scene: the pet wagging while the children point at the web

pages.text: {{hero}} and {{sibling}} ran to the hut. The web is still.
pages.illustrationHint: flat three-ink scene: children tiptoeing to the hut

choice.prompt: The wasp is in the web. {{sibling}} can fix the web.
choice.consequenceForFirst: {{hero}} and {{sibling}} fix the web. The wasp can jump up. It is a big win!
choice.consequenceForSecond: {{hero}} runs in the sun. The wasp is still in the web. {{hero}} ran back to fix it.

stories.offlineTask: Find something small and careful outside. Tell your grown-up about it.

stories.title: The Ship Song

pages.text: {{hero}} and {{pet}} can see the ship. The big ship is at the dock.
pages.illustrationHint: flat three-ink scene: a ship at a dock with {{city}} shapes behind

pages.text: {{pet}} can think. Is the ship a gift to me? {{pet}} ran to the ship.
pages.illustrationHint: flat three-ink scene: the pet running excitedly to the ship

pages.text: Not so fast. {{hero}} put a hand up. The ship is a bath ship. It must be scrubbed thin.
pages.illustrationHint: flat three-ink scene: {{hero}} holding up a hand, bucket and brush nearby

pages.text: The ship was a gift to {{pet}}! {{pet}} can sit in the ship and sing.
pages.illustrationHint: flat three-ink scene: the pet sitting proudly in the clean ship

choice.prompt: {{pet}} has the ship. The moth has no ship.
options: The moth can sit in the ship with {{pet}}.
The ship is not big. The moth can not fit.
choice.consequenceForFirst: The moth sat in the ship. The ship ran with the wind. {{hero}} sang a song!
choice.consequenceForSecond: {{pet}} sat in the ship. The moth sat on the dock. The song was sad. Sit with me! The song was big and glad.

stories.offlineTask: Go and sing a ship song with your grown-up.
